response: {"thought": "語意層沒有取消的定義，需要從資料推斷哪個 status 代碼代表取消。比較各狀態的出貨、付款成功與退款情況，看哪一個代碼符合取消訂單的特徵。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN p.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_ok FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'ok') p ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status;", "SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_with_refund FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status;"]}}
